title: audio.sample.decode result
description: What the sample declares, and a bounded envelope of what it contains.

name.description: The NAME chunk, empty when the file carries none.

sample_rate.description: Frames per second, as the VHDR declares it. Zero is reported rather than corrected: the file says what it says.

loop_frames.description: Frames of the repeating part; zero when the sample does not loop.

form_bytes.description: Bytes the whole FORM occupies from the requested offset, header included, as its own length field declares it. What a caller recording where this sample is needs, without re-parsing the container to find out.

envelope.description: One min/max pair per waveform column. Both extremes, not an average: averaging a waveform toward zero is how a loud sample ends up looking like silence.
